summary: Milestone 4 — Price Intelligence & Market Benchmarking: BACKEND endpoint + integration testing complete. 25/25 tests pass (11 pre-existing unit tests for analytics pure functions + 14 new endpoint/integration tests). Verified: backfill idempotency, products summary contract & seeded data, product history sort order + 404, vendor comparison contract + 404, alerts contract, dashboard smart_alerts merge (source='price_intelligence'), multi-tenant isolation (same-tenant staff sees same data; cross-tenant does not leak seeded product), POST /api/purchases ingest hook (eligible items inserted; items without canonical fields skipped), PATCH /api/purchases/{pid}/items/{idx} re-ingest hook (idempotent).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: PATCH /purchases/{pid}/items/{idx} only accepts editable fields {raw_name, quantity, unit_price, total, pack_size}. Canonical fields (canonical_unit, canonical_product_id, price_per_unit) are re-derived by the downstream normalize_item/resolve pipeline on each edit — this is correct and covered by _reingest_price_intelligence, but the response body's 'price_intelligence.inserted' will only be > 0 if the item already had resolvable canonical fields (or if the normalization pipeline resolves them). This is existing/expected behavior.

Minor: backfill_from_purchases returns 'purchases_with_items' (a derived count) which was not explicitly mentioned in the contract. Contract (purchases_scanned, observations_inserted, observations_skipped, skip_reasons) is satisfied.
Alert clearing: _evaluate_alert_for_product correctly deletes stale alerts when condition no longer holds — verified indirectly; idempotent backfill maintains consistent alert state.
